lines.en: I crawl along the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 我的壳高高拱起，像一枚盾
lines.en: My shell arches high like a shield.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴伸在后面，拖出一道浅痕
lines.en: My tail trails behind, leaving a shallow line.

lines.zh: 我用最后一对腿推着走
lines.en: I push along with my hindmost legs.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，沙上有细纹
lines.en: Fine grooves mark the sand where I pass.
I crawl slowly toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 被水推了一下，我又往前走
lines.en: Pushed by the current, I keep going.
I follow the tideline.

lines.zh: 我钻进沙里，只露一个壳顶
lines.en: I burrow in, only my shell showing.

lines.zh: 我从沙里出来，壳上还是湿的
lines.en: I come out of the sand, shell still wet.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，贴着底走
lines.en: I keep my body low, hugging the floor.
I crawl over broken shell.
I am not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，朝浅滩去
lines.en: I change course for the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的壳被水草刮了一下
lines.en: A weed scrapes my shell.

lines.zh: 水退的时候，我往深处挪
lines.en: When the tide drops, I move deeper.
I follow the edge of a stone.
I pause, then crawl on.

lines.zh: 我趴在浅海的沙上，不动
lines.en: I lie on the shallow sand, still.
Two grooves run across my shell.
My line is older than the dinosaurs.
Water runs over my shell.
I stretch my thin tail.
The light in the shallows is good.
I need not surface.
Something shifts beneath the fine sand.

lines.zh: 我的腿很细，撑不住大动作
lines.en: My legs are thin; they cannot bear sudden moves.

lines.zh: 我这样趴了几百年也不腻
lines.en: Lying like this for ages does not bore me.

lines.zh: 潮水把我往岸边推了一点
lines.en: The tide nudged me shoreward.

lines.zh: 我不躲，我也没什么好躲的
lines.en: I do not hide; I have little to hide from.
My shell is hard, harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我抬了一下尾剑，又放下
lines.en: I lift my tail spine and lower it.
I raise my eyes to you from the sand.
Your feet are in the shallows.
I work my shell a little deeper into the sand

lines.zh: 你的影子在水底很清楚
lines.en: Your shadow is clear on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我不是什么危险的东西
lines.en: I am nothing dangerous.
You bend down, and I pull in.
We are very near, and the water is shallow.
Are you going to catch me?

lines.zh: 我的壳朝向你，那是本能
lines.en: My shell turns to you; it is instinct.
I dig into the sand a little.
I pull in, shell only.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的壳敲出响声
lines.en: That rang my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢翻过来，翻得很费力
lines.en: I right myself with effort.
I have no voice to make.
I tuck my legs in tighter.
A pale line opens across my shell
I back into the sand, half buried.
This crack will stay with me a long while
I stay there, unmoving.
You struck too hard.
There is a smell in the water.
I am not fussy; I eat whatever is edible.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向挪了一点
lines.en: I shift a little that way.
Can I even reach that much?

lines.zh: 你放在沙上，我慢慢过去
lines.en: Leave it on the sand and I will come slowly.
I test with a leg.
I will not snatch; I wait for you to step back.
I sniff; not much smell.
I go around it.
I go on crawling.
You stepped on me; I pulled in.
I slide a stretch from the push.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞在石头上，响了一声
lines.en: My shell knocks a stone, once.
I do not retreat; I press lower.
Mud clouds around us.
Look, I can hardly even roll over.

lines.zh: 这一下把我卡在石缝里
lines.en: That wedged me in a crevice.
I work my way out slowly.
I back a few steps into the water.
A shallow mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 浅海里总会遇到另一个
lines.en: There is always another in the shallows.
We lie side by side on the sand.
My shell is a little broader.

lines.zh: 我们把沙翻起来，埋住卵
lines.en: We turn the sand over and bury the eggs.
The tide will watch over them.
We do not speak, nor need to.

lines.zh: 两片壳在沙上留下两道沟
lines.en: Two shells leave two grooves in the sand.
My kind never quarrel.
Its tail spine touches my shell.

lines.zh: 每年这个季节，都会遇上
lines.en: Every year at this season, we meet.
I grip with my legs; it will not hold.
It is bigger than my mouth.
I nudge it with my shell.
I press it into the sand.
I slowly rake at it.
I cannot move it, so I leave it.
It rolled behind a stone.
I push it toward my mouth.
This is too hard.
I nudge it with a claw and let go
Something small stirs on the sand
I move that way.
Not danger, only curiosity.
I see now: a piece of shell.
The water pushed it over.

lines.zh: 我把壳尖慢慢转向那边
lines.en: I swing the point of my shell that way

lines.zh: 这一点距离，我爬得过去
lines.en: I can crawl that distance.
I stop and look first.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，也没什么好怕的
lines.en: I have no teeth, and little to fear.
I lie back down.
I follow slowly.
It moves too fast.
I crawl along its trail.
The water carries it away.
I stop to rest.
This sand slope is hard going.
I take another path.
It is no longer there.
I only wanted a look.
I slowly turn my body.

lines.zh: 我把壳往里收，护住自己
lines.en: I draw my shell in to guard myself.

lines.zh: 我抬尾剑，其实没什么力
lines.en: I raise my tail spine; it has little force.
I am not made for fighting.
That did not even push the sand.
I pull back in.
Step on me if you like; I will not strike back.
I only blocked.
My legs are too thin to brace.
I retreat into the water.
Staying like this gets us nowhere.

lines.zh: 浅海的沙上多了一片壳
lines.en: A shell appears on the shallow sand.
The tide carried me ashore.
The water here is shallow and warm.
I push the top of my shell up through the sand

lines.zh: 我这一族在这里活过很久
lines.en: My kind lived here long ago.

lines.zh: 壳上还带着深海的味道
lines.en: My shell still carries the deep sea's smell.
I slowly unfold my legs.
Sea grass beside me.
The light on the surface shifts.

lines.zh: 我挑了一处有细沙的地方
lines.en: I chose a spot of fine sand.
I settle and flatten my body.
Plenty of small things here.
The water heats up; I crawl deeper.

lines.zh: 我从石上滚下去，壳磕了一下
lines.en: I roll off the stone and my shell knocks.

lines.zh: 我就在水里，可这水太深了
lines.en: I live in water, but this is too deep.
The shock flips me.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打进沙里，离我很近
lines.en: Something drives into the sand close by.
That force pins me to the sand.
Nothing to eat in the shallows.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅水，我全身一缩
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows; I clench.

lines.zh: 这里干得一滴水也没有
lines.en: Here there is not a drop of water
